sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Dense 29.6B vision-language model with a ViT-G/14 perception encoder and 128K context, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic use. Emits channel-scoped reasoning and XML-style ATEM tool calls rather than JSON, so it needs the dedicated `muse_glimmer` tool-call and reasoning parsers.
